title: EGRADX event
description: A CloudEvents 1.0 event in structured JSON, as every EGRADX SDK writes and reads it (Java: com.egradx.events.EgradxEvent). Extension attributes carry the W3C trace context and the request id, so a handler continues the publisher's trace.

subject.description: What the event is about (an id). The Kafka key.

time.description: When the change happened, ISO-8601 in UTC.

organizationid.description: The organization the event belongs to.

traceparent.description: W3C traceparent of the publishing request.

tracestate.description: W3C tracestate of the publishing request.
